newsitem.title: USA: Rubin says no recommendations on Fed candidates.
newsitem.headline: Rubin says no recommendations on Fed candidates.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said on Tuesday President Bill Clinton had not yet been given recommendations on candidates to replace the departing Federal Reserve Governors Janet Yellen and Lawrence Lindsey.
"We have not made recommendations," Rubin told reporters. "We are working on it, but we have not made recommendations."
In December Yellen was nominated to chair the president's Council of Economic Advisers. On January 10, Lindsey announced he had submitted his resignation from the Federal Reserve to Clinton.
